rachel: Morning — EU ingest emitted a cluster of 2-4h late events, recompute queue doubled. Shared pools showing token-tail latency. Can we add a preflight/admission step so backfills don't trample live p95? cc @chun @matt

chun: Quick idea: add /replays/preflight that returns {accepted:bool, suggested_fallback:string, cost_estimate:string}. That lets console show upfront if a job will be downgraded.

matt: Also need a deterministic admission rule: background only if region_background_tokens + job.tokens <= bg_budget. If not, preflight returns suggested_fallback=passive.

rachel: Agreed. Also enable a tiny dedupe precheck for late arrivals (precheck.dedupe=true) to skip already-applied keys. Saves tokens.

replay-bot: New job queued rp-20260412-09 tenant=gamma estimated_tokens=850k precheck.dedupe=true

ops: Telemetry asks: add tags replay.preflight.result (accepted|downgraded), replay.routing.pool (shared|dedicated|spot), replay.precheck.dedupe_rate. Billing unaffected. Also request short dedicated quota for canary via rb-tool.

chun: Safety: circuit-breaker if api_p95 > 2x baseline or shared_queue_depth > 4k then preflight forces suggested_fallback=passive. Implement behind ff and allow a one-tenant canary.

lina: UX: we'll call preflight before final submit and show a pill: "Assigned to spot-dedicated (may be preempted). Est cost: $X. Click to request quota" or "Scheduled as passive to protect live API". Keep it subtle.

matt: Implementation plan: 1) scheduler accepts preflight/admission_hint behind feature flag; 2) console calls preflight and shows results; 3) run 2h canary for one opt-in tenant; 4) monitor p95, dedupe_rate, and token burn; revert ff on regressions.

ops: Quota ticket created: rb-tool quota request --tenant gamma --pool dedicated-eu --tokens 900000 --hours 2. Monitoring on standby.

rachel: OK — I'll own scheduler PR and ff. Lina will do console preflight. We'll post canary outcomes here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
